content:
Notice: If you listen carefully to the song, you'll notice that the progression
C Em G is played like that: C for 1 stroke, Em and G for 1/2 stroke. Keep that in 
mind while playing.

Capo on 3rd fret

* = strike once and hold for 4 bars

[Intro]
| [ch]C[/ch]  | [ch]Em[/ch] | [ch]G[/ch]  | x4
| [ch]C[/ch]  | [ch]D[/ch]  |

[Verse 1]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]              [ch]Em[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]         [ch]C[/ch]        [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] 
 Oh, brother I can't, I can't get through.[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]Em[/ch]
I've been trying hard to reach you[/tab]
[tab]  [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]C[/ch]                  [ch]D[/ch]
'Cause I don't know what to do.[/tab]

[Verse 2]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]              [ch]Em[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]         [ch]C[/ch]     [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] 
 Oh, brother I can't believe it's true.[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]C[/ch]                [ch]Em[/ch]
I'm so scared about the future[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch]               [ch]D[/ch]
And I want to talk to you.[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]C[/ch]                [ch]D[/ch]    [ch]Em[/ch]*
Oh, I want to talk to you.[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab]          [ch]C[/ch]                 [ch]Em[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]    [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
You could take a picture of something you see.[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]             [ch]Em[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]    [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
In the future where will I be?[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]Em[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
You could climb a ladder up to the sun[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]Em[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]
Or write a song nobody had sung[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]                   [ch]D[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]*
Or do something that's never been done.[/tab]

[Verse 3]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]         [ch]Em[/ch]      [ch]G[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
 Are you lost or incomplete?[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]C[/ch]            [ch]Em[/ch]     [ch]G[/ch]         [ch]C[/ch]                  [ch]D[/ch]
Do you feel like a puzzle, You can't find your missing piece.[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]       [ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
Tell me how you feeeel.[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                 [ch]Em[/ch]
Well, I feel like they're talking[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch]                 [ch]D[/ch]
In a language I don't speak.[/tab]
[tab]             [ch]C[/ch]             [ch]D[/ch]   [ch]Em[/ch]*
And they're talking it to me.[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab]       [ch]C[/ch]                 [ch]Em[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]    [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
So you take a picture of something you see.[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]             [ch]Em[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
In the future where will I be?[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]Em[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
You could climb a ladder up to the sun[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]Em[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]
Or write a song nobody had sung[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]                   [ch]D[/ch]
Or do something that's never been done.[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                   [ch]D[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]*
Do something that's never been done.[/tab]

[Solo]
| [ch]Am[/ch] | [ch]C[/ch]  | [ch]Em[/ch] | [ch]D[/ch]  | x4
| [ch]C[/ch]  | [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] |         x3
| [ch]C[/ch]  | [ch]D[/ch]  |

[Chorus]
[tab]       [ch]C[/ch]                                     [ch]Em[/ch]      [ch]G[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
So you don't know where you're going and you want to talk.[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                                   [ch]Em[/ch]     [ch]G[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
And you feel like you're going where you've been before.[/tab]
[tab]            [ch]C[/ch]                            [ch]Em[/ch]     [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
You'll tell anyone who'll listen but you feel ignored.[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                           [ch]Em[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]
Nothing's really making any sense at all.[/tab]

[Outro]
[tab]      [ch]C[/ch]           [ch]D[/ch]
Let's talk, let's talk.[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]C[/ch]           [ch]D[/ch]     [ch]Em[/ch]
Let's talk, let's talk.[/tab]
